posts.author: mike_312
posts.body: Hi everyone, I wanted to know if it is possible to make a skill that changes the player's battle sprite but that at the end of the battle, it returns to the initial sprite. I use rpg maker mz and I have the yanfly add-ons.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Make an action sequence with 'change actor graphic' event command. Then you can put in the plugin settings a post-battle common event that returns all the actor graphics to normal.
